run_check_structure: run the check_structure function to validate markdown API docs have correct section ordering and required sections
run_check_examples: run the check_examples function to verify every C++ example file is referenced in at least one markdown file
run_check_links: run the check_links function to detect duplicate file entries in the mkdocs.yml navigation
run_full_lint: run the script as a CLI to lint all API markdown files for structure, examples, and navigation issues
review_report_function: review the report function that tracks and prints numbered warnings with rule tags for documentation linting
